Subject: Clarification regarding visitor arrangements

Dear Team,

I am writing to ensure we provide the best possible experience for our upcoming visitors. The email mentioned that they have dietary preferences and will be staying over, but it did not specify the details.

Could you please provide more information on their specific dietary requirements? Additionally, are there any other specific arrangements or preferences we should be aware of for their stay?

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
